rows.name: returned-can
rows.notes: Approved. Single clearly empty opened tin placed on damp morning ground before canonical weathered cabover front wheel. No pack or Bori remains; no human actor, loot pile or invented landmark. Partial technical front detail preserves vehicle identity. Tin remains recognizable at360/480. Compared with original night encirclement: correct next-morning aftermath without implying dogs still present.

rows.name: arcade-night
rows.notes: Approved v2. Same elderly Korean pair, faces/clothes/hands, table/puck/pushers, dead cabinets and plush machine as original. Windows/door now blue-black night; exterior windows/street lamps and cabinet screens remain unlit. Faces and table readable at360/480 using restrained ambient illumination. No new companion identity or electrical light introduced.

rows.name: sejong-night
rows.notes: Approved. Same portrait administrative masses/elevated opening, overgrown avenue and rear Dalguji. Deep night replaces daylight break; architecture remains dark, only existing camper amber/red practicals reflected. Technical separation of cab and box retained. No invented people/landmarks or powered city lights.360/480 preserve the empty city and small vehicle composition.
